source.rights_note: Copyright-restricted commercial-game sprites are evidence only. No source pixels, palette, costume, contours, exact silhouette, sheet layout, tracing, choreography, redistribution, or close imitation enter this successor.

motion_dungeon.determinism: candidate rebuild repeated byte-identically under current builder/runtime

actual_render_inspection.method: Exact authoritative 83-frame H.264 candidate decoded and inspected as a complete frame sheet plus decisive-key sheet.

tango.basis: Shared offset-ready/query/deep-coil establishes asymmetrical anticipation. Variant A commits from LEFT support into low-right acceleration, a one-frame right catch, four-frame deep absorb, torso overshoot, one-frame support reacquire, and a new x29 right-biased ready. Variant B commits from RIGHT support with a slower loaded release into one-frame high-left whip, one-frame opposite catch, four-frame torsion hold, one-frame secondary-lag snapback, four-frame broad-support recovery debt, and a distinct x19 back-weighted ready. Branch timing and silhouettes are visibly nonuniform; support changes occur only at decisive keys; connective arcs do not cross support topology; neither branch reverse-interpolates or returns to the shared idle address.

noodle_queen.taste: The branch split has authored attitude rather than palette-bank bookkeeping: A is low/crossing/braking; B is high/whipping/torsional.
noodle_queen.function: The zero-time selection rule remains structurally true while the first body consequence after selection visibly commits different support owners, cadence, silhouettes, lag, and recovery.
noodle_queen.contempt: Not placeholder motion: the same precommit state yields two performances with different force stories and different final debt addresses.

zero_time_selection.visible_consequence: A/B branches share K00-K02 then visibly diverge in support owner, cadence, silhouette, overshoot/lag, and recovery address.
